skills.name: Brace
skills.description: Regain 2 stacks of strong. 25% Shield strength restored per stack at turn start. One stack lost per hit. Applies deflecting (deflect next melee attack). Upgrade: Regain 4 stacks.

skills.name: Fortress
skills.description: Brace restores 1 armour point per stack of strong.

skills.name: Protect
skills.description: All direct damage to adjacent friendly unit halved and shared with Princeps. Armour/resistance applied separately.

skills.name: Guardian Angel
skills.description: Protect now redirects Status effects toward the protecting character.

skills.name: Bastion
skills.description: +10 to all resistances. Maximum resistance increased from 50% to 60%.

skills.name: Repair
skills.description: Applies jury rigged for two turns. Immune to status effects affecting shields. Removes shield-broken, exposed and sundered.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.description: While character has a working shield, counts as cover. Upgrade: counts as high cover.

skills.name: Shield Wall
skills.description: Applies Shield Walled and Exhausted, restores Shield Strength to full. Shield walled increases Shield Strength Maximum to 250%; exhausted removes all strong stacks.

skills.name: Hardened
skills.description: +10% max health. Upgrade: +20%.

skills.name: The Best Defense
skills.description: 20% shield damage at full Shield strength. Upgrade 1: 40%. Upgrade 2: 60%.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Forces enemy to attack taunting character at start of their turn. Range: 6 hexes.

skills.name: Bull Rush
skills.description: Shield bludgeoning damage. Move in straight line, knocking down enemies and allies alike.

skills.name: Frighten
skills.description: -10 morale to all enemies within range. 3 hex radius.

skills.name: Flawless Defence
skills.description: Applies defending status, increasing all resistance to highest value. Max resistance +10%, costs 3 movement. Upgrade: +15%.

skills.name: Adrenaline Junkie
skills.description: +50% damage when Health < 50% of Maximum Health.

skills.name: Avenger
skills.description: When ally incapacitated/killed, Shield Strength restored to full and +20% damage for rest of battle.

skills.name: Nimble
skills.description: Lowers movement penalty from light or heavier armor by -1. Upgrade: -2.

skills.name: Headbutt
skills.description: Unarmed damage. Sets attacker movement to 0. Applies Weakened. If target already Weakened/Harried: Stunned instead.

skills.name: Battering Ram
skills.description: +1 base damage to equipped shields in all conditions. Upgrade: +3 total.

skills.name: War Cry
skills.description: Applies stunned to enemies in 1 hex radius. Upgrade: 2 hex radius.

skills.name: Knockdown
skills.description: Unarmed damage. Applies knocked down.

skills.name: Opportunist
skills.description: Attacks of opportunity apply Weakened. Upgrade: applies Stunned.

skills.name: Stand Fast
skills.description: Allies in 2 hex radius immune to crippled/stunned/stuck/knocked down for 2 turns. Also removes those effects.

skills.name: Immoveable
skills.description: Immunity to being moved by rebuke, shove, Shield Push, Push and Shove, Repulse, Counter-Advance.

skills.name: Interrupt
skills.description: Attacks next target that moves in 120° cone in front. Slightly more damage. Range 12 hexes. Upgrade: 160° cone.

skills.name: Vigilant
skills.description: Interrupt hits up to 2 targets instead of 1.

skills.name: Gracing shot
skills.description: Applies gracing to self. Next ranged attacks deal slashing damage with -33% accuracy and shred 1 armour. Upgrade: shred 2.

skills.name: Steady Hands
skills.description: 100% critical chance for all ranged reaction attacks (Interrupt and Overwatch).

skills.name: Point Blank
skills.description: 100% critical chance for ranged attacks against adjacent opponents. Provokes Attack of Opportunity.

skills.name: Rebuke
skills.description: 3 bludgeoning damage. Pushes target 1 hex away. Usable on friendly characters. Upgrade: doubles damage.

skills.name: Powerful Kick
skills.description: Rebuke also applies knocked down. Upgrade: applies Tactical effect to archer.

skills.name: Overwatch
skills.description: Shoots each enemy that attacks an ally within range (once per enemy). Weapon damage, 6 hex radius. Deflected by shield.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.description: Shoots 2 arrows at 2 targets with -30% accuracy, 30% chance to miss. Weapon damage, deflected by shields.

skills.name: Lure
skills.description: Bludgeoning damage. Prevents target from using cover (lured effect). Range 6 hexes.

skills.name: Pinning shots
skills.description: All ranged hits within 2 hexes apply crippled. Upgrade 1: range 4 hexes. Upgrade 2: applies Stuck instead.

skills.name: Barrage
skills.description: On each shot, regain action point. -33% accuracy. Lasts 1 turn only.

skills.name: Versatile
skills.description: After any attack, next attack of the other type (melee↔ranged) deals +50% damage. Upgrade: also +1 armour penetrating.

skills.name: Skirmisher
skills.description: Versatile has 100% critical chance when previous attack killed a target.

skills.name: Arrow Stab
skills.description: Weapon damage at half damage, inflicts bleeding. When flanked, target also stunned.

skills.name: Find weakness
skills.description: Grants Finding Weakness each turn. Next attack inflicts Bleeding, Weakened, or Harried.

skills.name: Ranging shot
skills.description: Range 4 hexes. Applies spotted in 2 hex radius (spotted = full damage regardless of distance). Finds invisible enemies, breaks invisibility for 2 turns.

skills.name: Spotter
skills.description: Ranging shots now shoots two arrows at chosen spots.

skills.name: Eagle Eye
skills.description: Next ranged attack ignores target's shield strength and cannot be Resisted.

skills.name: Seize ground
skills.description: Start combat with double movement for first 2 turns. Killing target >12 hexes away replenishes a random skill charge.

skills.name: Marksman
skills.description: +2 accuracy (range). Upgrade: +4.

skills.name: Mark target
skills.description: Applies marked to target up to 10 hexes. Target can be attacked at any range. Next ranged attack deals +25% damage; if killed by ranged attack, effect jumps to next target. Upgrade: +50%.

skills.name: Walk Your Shots
skills.description: +2 optimal range (not max range). Upgrade 1: another +2. Upgrade 2: +6 total.

skills.name: Assist
skills.description: Weapon damage. Target provokes attack of opportunity as if they moved. Nearby allies may attack.

skills.name: Field Medic
skills.description: +25% health restored when healing. Upgrade: +50%.

skills.name: Cure
skills.description: Removes bleeding, burned, burning, and poisoned.

skills.name: Good as New
skills.description: Cure also restores 25% health per status effect removed.

skills.name: Interference
skills.description: When any enemy in reach attacks an ally, this character may perform an attack of opportunity.

skills.name: Logistics
skills.description: +2 movement to allies in 3 hex radius for 2 turns. Upgrade: +3 movement, 4 hex radius.

skills.name: Poisoner
skills.description: 5% chance any attack inflicts Poison. Upgrade: 10%.

skills.name: Revive
skills.description: Bring incapacitated ally back with 25% health. Revived character can move, no action point. Provokes attack of opportunity. Upgrade: 50% health.

skills.name: Curse
skills.description: Apply Weakened to multiple enemies in 6 hex radius.

skills.name: War Horn
skills.description: +20% damage to allies for 2 turns in 3 hex radius. Upgrade: 3 turns, 4 hex radius.

skills.name: Guidance
skills.description: Downing enemy grants +3 morale to allies within 3 hexes. Upgrade: +5.

skills.name: Ruse
skills.description: All enemies in area move out. Range 8 hexes, 1 hex radius (7 hexes total).

skills.name: Embarrassing ruse
skills.description: Ruse also lowers morale by -10 for enemies in hexes. Upgrade: -20.

skills.name: Bolstering presence
skills.description: Grants bolstered to all adjacent allies, allowing them to not fail morale checks.

skills.name: Inspire
skills.description: Grants an ally who spent their action point a new one. Provokes attack of opportunity. Range 8 hexes.

skills.name: Orator
skills.description: Inspire also resets cooldown of skills of the ally.

skills.name: Rousing speech
skills.description: Restore 15 health or 25% total health of allies in 6 hex radius. Upgrade: 2 charges.

skills.name: Deathblow
skills.description: +50% damage against stunned, knocked down, and sundered characters. Upgrade: also applies to stuck and crippled.

skills.name: Shredder
skills.description: +1 armor shredding for staves and pikes.

skills.name: Reckless
skills.description: +25% base damage and +1 armour shredding for 2 turns. No resistances, cannot use tactical weapons. Upgrade: +50% base damage.

skills.name: Sunder
skills.description: Sets shield strength to 0 before dealing damage. Cannot be resisted (except hunkering down). Applies sundering effect.

skills.name: Fortune favoured
skills.description: +5% critical hit chance. Upgrade: +10%.

skills.name: Quick lunge
skills.description: Half damage weapon attack, cripples enemies, no armour shred. Range 1-2 hexes.

skills.name: Quick feet
skills.description: No longer triggers attacks of opportunity when moving around enemies (only when disengaging).

skills.name: Finisher
skills.description: Attacking stuck/knocked down/stunned enemy restores 10% health. Killing them restores action point and resets Deathblow. Upgrade: 20% health.

skills.name: Cheap shot
skills.description: Applies Savage to self. Next attack is a critical hit.

skills.name: Assassinate
skills.description: +40% damage against enemy leaders (characters with laurels in portrait).

skills.name: Focus Master
skills.description: +1 Focus Maximum. Upgrade: +2 total.

skills.name: Rush
skills.description: Restore action point. Upgrade: 5 focus cost, 3 charges.

skills.name: Lone Wolf
skills.description: Critical chance doubled and +20% dodge when all allies are ≥6 hexes away.

skills.name: Sneak Attack
skills.description: Off-hand weapon/Unarmed damage. Generates 1 focus. +50% damage first 2 turns. Upgrade: +100%.

skills.name: Marathon
skills.description: Applies inexhaustible: unlimited movement until character stops.

skills.name: First strike
skills.description: +50% damage against targets with full health.

skills.name: Shiv
skills.description: Quick off-hand attack at half damage, no action point required.

skills.name: Bloodthirsty
skills.description: Killing enemy grants 1 stack of Bloodthirsty (+5% damage). Upgrade: +15% per stack. Max 2 stacks = 30% extra total.

skills.name: Kill on Ground
skills.description: Finish off incapacitated enemy, inflict -10 morale on nearby enemies in 5 hex radius.

skills.name: Quick-witted
skills.description: +1 focus gained per attack.

skills.name: Born ready
skills.description: Start with 4 focus points. Upgrade 1: 8. Upgrade 2: 12.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Next attack has 50% chance to miss; if dodged, no damage or status effects.

skills.name: Slippery
skills.description: Dodge lasts until beginning of character's next turn (instead of ending after first attack).

skills.name: Duel
skills.description: Calls out specific enemy; next attack deals double damage, inflicts stunned and bleeding. Range 12 hexes.

skills.name: Tactical advance
skills.description: No attacks of opportunity while moving. Upgrade: +2 movement and activates traps.

skills.name: Clear Path
skills.description: On killing target, replenish 2 movement to nearby allies and self. 2 hex radius.

skills.name: Pugilist
skills.description: +1 focus per attack when using unarmed skills.

skills.name: Reaper
skills.description: While active, killing an enemy restores action point, resets skills, and restores movement.

skills.name: Pankration
skills.description: +100% unarmed damage.

skills.name: Feint
skills.description: Move through hex occupied by enemy, ending in hex behind them. Usable on friendly characters too.

skills.name: Boast
skills.description: On killing enemy, allies gain +10 morale; on failure, all enemies gain +10 morale. Upgrade: grants Savage on success.

skills.name: Heavy skirmisher
skills.description: Rank 1: can wear strong armour. Rank 2: -1 movement for all body armour.
